svg.text: Supervised fine-tuning on the gold traces
6,000 instances, one C1 image and one gold trace each
one test image, no reference, no mask
user and image tokens are masked out
Reinforcement learning from the model's own rollouts
sample G = 4 rollouts from the current policy
score every rollout against the gold tags
anomalous: R = format (0/1) + verdict (0/1) + ½ · type (0 to 1) + ½ · location (0/1)
normal: format + verdict, max 2.0 · two unweighted reward functions, four bounded sub-signals, max 3.0
no value network, the group is the baseline
KL to the reference is logged, not in the loss
β = 0, the reference stays the SFT model
update the policy with the clipped surrogate, ε = 0.2, lr 1e-6, batch 8

The two training stages of the thesis. Stage 1 fits the gold traces by cross-entropy with the vision encoder frozen. Stage 2 starts from that checkpoint, samples groups of four rollouts, scores them, and updates all three blocks.
